promo_floodfill_enabled.description: Kill switch for the Color Shift cross-promo banner

promo_min_sessions.description: Banner never shows before this app launch number (1 = first launch)

promo_cooldown_days.description: Minimum days between app launches that show the banner

promo_dismiss_snooze_days.description: Days the banner stays hidden after the user taps X

promo_max_impressions.description: Lifetime cap on launches that show the banner

promo_max_dismissals.description: Hide the banner forever after this many dismissals

promo_click_snooze_days.description: Days the banner stays hidden after the user taps Play but does not install

promo_max_clicks.description: Hide the banner forever after this many Play taps
